Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.vaultmesh

Class KfeVaultMeshSettlementClient

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.vaultmesh.KfeVaultMeshSettlementClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.vaultmesh.enabled", havingValue="true") public class KfeVaultMeshSettlementClient extends Object implements com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort
Production HTTP adapter from kfe-service to the Vault mesh. Signing is available only through Intent-bound PSBT requests.

Optional client mTLS via kfe.vaultmesh.tls.* (PEM or keystore/truststore). Every request uses the configured mTLS operator or workload identity.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeVaultMeshSettlementClient

      @Autowired public KfeVaultMeshSettlementClient(org.springframework.boot.web.client.RestTemplateBuilder restTemplateBuilder, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.base-url}") String baseUrl, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.connect-timeout-ms:10000}") long connectTimeoutMs, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.read-timeout-ms:20000}") long readTimeoutMs, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.api-token:}") String apiToken, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.enabled:true}") boolean tlsEnabled, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.cert-path:}") String tlsCertPath, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.key-path:}") String tlsKeyPath, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.ca-path:}") String tlsCaPath, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.keystore-path:}") String tlsKeystorePath, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.keystore-password:}") String tlsKeystorePassword, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.keystore-type:PKCS12}") String tlsKeystoreType, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.truststore-path:}") String tlsTruststorePath, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.truststore-password:}") String tlsTruststorePassword, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.truststore-type:PKCS12}") String tlsTruststoreType, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.tls.hostname-verification:true}") boolean tlsHostnameVerification, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.constitution.hash:}") String constitutionHash, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.constitution.member-count:3}") int constitutionMemberCount, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.constitution.threshold:2}") int constitutionThreshold, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.urls:}") String vaultUrlsCsv, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.transport:tor}") String transport, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.proxy.socks-host:}") String socksHost, @Value("${kfe.vaultmesh.proxy.socks-port:9050}") int socksPort)
      Creates the production mesh transport, validates TLS and Tor/direct transport settings, and fixes the Vault roster and constitution thresholds for the lifetime of this adapter. Legacy API-token authentication is rejected; Tor transport cannot run without mTLS. Thresholds are clamped to positive values and bounded by the configured member count.
      Parameters:
      restTemplateBuilder - base Spring HTTP client builder
      objectMapper - serializer/parser for Vault mesh protocol messages
      baseUrl - required HTTPS coordinator URL
      connectTimeoutMs - connection timeout in milliseconds
      readTimeoutMs - response-read timeout in milliseconds
      apiToken - removed bearer-token setting; any nonblank value causes startup failure
      tlsEnabled - whether client mTLS is requested
      tlsCertPath - PEM client certificate path
      tlsKeyPath - PEM client private key path
      tlsCaPath - PEM CA certificate path
      tlsKeystorePath - optional client keystore path
      tlsKeystorePassword - client keystore password
      tlsKeystoreType - client keystore format
      tlsTruststorePath - optional truststore path
      tlsTruststorePassword - truststore password
      tlsTruststoreType - truststore format
      tlsHostnameVerification - whether TLS hostname identity is checked
      constitutionHash - expected constitution digest used for receipt validation
      constitutionMemberCount - expected maximum constitution member count
      constitutionThreshold - minimum constitution signing threshold
      vaultUrlsCsv - optional comma-separated Vault member URLs
      transport - selected mesh network transport
      socksHost - SOCKS proxy host when Tor routing is selected
      socksPort - SOCKS proxy port
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - for removed token usage or insecure Tor without mTLS
      IllegalArgumentException - for malformed or non-HTTPS Vault URLs

    • signPsbt

      public com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshPsbtReceipt signPsbt(com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshPsbtRequest request)

      Parameters:
      request - intent/session identity, bucket, destination, amount, and funded PSBT
      Returns:
      accepted signed-PSBT receipt, fail-stop receipt, or explicit rejection

    • getDayStatus

      public com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.governance.VaultMeshDayStatus getDayStatus()
      Returns the UTC day epoch agreed by the configured Vault members, requiring the configured minimum agreement when multiple members are present. An interrupted or insufficient quorum produces a failed status rather than selecting one member's value.
      Specified by:
      getDayStatus in interface com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort
      Returns:
      agreed current day status or a failure status when the roster cannot establish quorum

    • voteDay

      public com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.governance.VaultMeshDayAdvanceResult voteDay(String voter, String dayEpoch)
      Submits a member vote for the requested day through the live coordinator. The supplied voter label is optional; the Vault derives identity from authenticated mTLS rather than trusting it.
      Specified by:
      voteDay in interface com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort
      Parameters:
      voter - optional display/reference label included in the request body
      dayEpoch - UTC day epoch being voted on
      Returns:
      vote success or a failed result describing coordinator/HTTP rejection

    • advanceDay

      public com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.governance.VaultMeshDayAdvanceResult advanceDay()
      Requests quorum-controlled advancement on every configured member without replaying a POST. Each coordinator persists its own calendar; advancing only one member cannot establish the calendar agreement required by getDayStatus(). Multi-member success is confirmed by reading that agreement after the requests, including when a POST response was lost.
      Specified by:
      advanceDay in interface com.kerosene.common.vaultmesh.settlement.VaultMeshSettlementPort
      Returns:
      agreed current day and whether a member acknowledged advancement, or a failure result
